text.p: Pen pictures of the probable VfB Stuttgart team for Saturday's German first division match against Bayern Munich:
Franz Wohlfahrt. Goalkeeper. Age 32. Austrian international who joined Stuttgart at start of the season. 1.90 metres tall and 90 kgs.
Thomas Schneider. Defender. 24. Joined club as 11-year-old but before this season had played only 36 times in the Bundesliga. Three goals this season.
Frank Verlaat. Defender. 28. Dutch international who used to play for Ajax Amsterdam before joining from Auxerre in 1995. A key member of the side. Three goals so far this season.
Hendrik Herzog. Defender. 28. Experienced former East German international who joined VfB in 1995 from Schalke. Used to play for FC Berlin. Usually man-to-man marker.
Matthias Hagner. Midfielder. Age 22. Former Eintracht Frankfurt player who joined at start of season and has an impressive six goals so far. Usually operates in middle of park.
Andreas Buck. Midfielder. 29. Joined from Freiburg in 1990. Experienced player who usually operates on right side of midfield. One goal this season.
Danny Schwarz, Midfielder. 22. Youngster who tends to operate in middle of park or right side. Stuttgart is his first big club.
Radloslav Gilewicz. Midfielder. 26. Polish player usually to be found on the left side of midfield. One goal to his credit this season.
Krasimir Balakov. Midfielder. Age 31. Bulgarian international who came from Sporting Lisbon in 1995. Plays just behind two strikers and has scored 13 goals this season.

Giovane Elber. Striker. Age 24. Brazilian international who is the star of the team. Can turn a match with a dazzling skill and has 17 goals to his credit this term. Heading for Bayern next season where he will step into Juergen Klinsmann's shoes.
Fredi Bobic. Striker. Age 25. Euro 96 forward who is club's top scorer with 18 goals. Bobic is more of a poacher but has a problem with his fiery temperament.
